software.name: CTD_SIMU_RAI
software.title: RAIR-Sim: compartmental simulator of radioactive iodine therapy response in metastatic thyroid cancer (MATLAB)

article.citation: M. Fusella Giuntini, C. Voyant, D. Taieb, D. Barbolosi. A computational framework for optimizing radioiodine therapy protocols in metastatic thyroid cancer. Scientific Reports 16 (2026) 27179

supported: explore radioiodine protocols for the two published profiles

outputs.definition: serum thyroglobulin over time (months), plotted to 80 months

rules: Never invent a value. Each input is given by the user, an exact unit conversion of a given value, or a documented default that the user explicitly accepts.
Use the canonical unit of each field; convert exactly and say so (for example 2 km -> 2000 m). Never mix a percentage and a fraction.
Ask when a request is ambiguous or a required input is missing; do not infer a number from a place name or a qualitative word.
Run the code unmodified. Report only what was actually computed, with quantity, unit and the input values used; never present a planned or unavailable run as a result.
State the scope and the limits below when you report a result.

Article: 50 patients (AP-HM, 2014–2016), MCMC-SAEM in Monolix; responders 72.5 % (mean T_d 66.6 months), non-responders 27.5 % (9.8 months); status indicated after two or three sessions instead of seven or eight.
limits: Research tool, not a clinical decision tool; population parameters; prospective validation needed.
Never give a protocol recommendation for a real patient.
execution_notice: This descriptor documents the software. It is not a registered WebSemantic adapter, an executable API, or evidence that the full scientific workflow has been validated.
